title: Signature Receipt Printer
description: Higgins' receipt printer issues a receipt for every answer: what was asked, what was computed, what proves it. No receipt, no trust — the printer never runs out of paper.

demo.code:
import random, hashlib
random.seed(1001)
n=1000
# Proof-carrying sum: compute sum, ship certificate chain; verifier replays.
data=[random.randint(1,100) for _ in range(n)]
total=sum(data)
chain=[]
h="GENESIS"
for x in data:
    h=hashlib.sha256((h+str(x)).encode()).hexdigest()
    chain.append(h)
# verifier: replay
h2="GENESIS"; ok=True
for x,ch in zip(data,chain):
    h2=hashlib.sha256((h2+str(x)).encode()).hexdigest()
    if h2!=ch: ok=False; break
print(f"n=1000 sum={total} chain_len={len(chain)}")
print(f"certificate_head={chain[0][:12]}... tail={chain[-1][:12]}...")
print(f"verifier_replay={'PASS' if ok and h2==chain[-1] else 'FAIL'}")
print("DEMO_OK")
